2026So Far: The Foreman Gets Outvoted, and Goldminers1 Closes to TwoIn progress · 11 weeks in · dahlilama 18-4, Goldminers1 16-6, Birdgangflyeagles 15-7

Eleven weeks in, rbanuelos3 took down the league leader with the top score of the week, Goldminers1 won his fourth straight to pull within two games, and a three-team trade reshuffled the deck. The evidence so far.

18-4dahlilama, two games clear

1,421points for dahlilama, league lead
307transactions so far

Objection sustained

rbanuelos3 beat dahlilama 129.96–124.80, the closest game of Week 11 at 5.16 points. It snapped dahlilama's five-game head-to-head win streak, and rbanuelos3's 129.96 was the top score of the week: his ninth career weekly high, the most in league history. That's two straight head-to-head wins for rbanuelos3, who's up to 10-12. dahlilama still cleared the median, so he went 1-1 and sits at 18-4, still the points leader at 1,421 and the futures favorite at +150.

Goldminers1 closes in

Goldminers1 beat kevinnguu 98.30–84.56 for his fourth straight head-to-head win. The Week 11 median landed at 97.62, and his 98.30 cleared it by 0.68, so it was a 2-0 week: he's 16-6, two games back of first, and second in points (1,367, 54 behind dahlilama). kevinnguu went 0-2 and has lost three straight head-to-head.

Eight trades and counting

Week 11 brought a three-team deal: dahlilama got David Montgomery and Jordan Love, MayockJr got Rico Dowdle and Drake London, and Bjspjs4 got Javonte Williams. That's Bjspjs4's eighth trade of 2026, and Drake London has now moved twice; Bjspjs4 got him from Goldminers1 back in Week 2. Bjspjs4 also beat showmeyourtd23 126.56–82.80, the biggest margin of the week (43.76), for his second straight head-to-head win. He's back to .500 at 11-11.

Birdgangflyeagles bounces back

After an 0-2 Week 10, Birdgangflyeagles beat elysianbeer 116.12–94.14 and went 2-0. He's 15-7 and third. elysianbeer went 0-2 and drops to 12-10.

Also in the file

  • juleon8 beat giJ03 127.56–85.88, the week's second-best score. He's 12-10, level with elysianbeer, and still has the fewest points against in the league (1,036).
  • Sleon1000 beat MayockJr 96.94–85.34 but finished 0.68 under the median, the week's only lucky win. That makes a four-way tie at 10-12: rbanuelos3, Sleon1000, kevinnguu and MayockJr.
  • MayockJr still leads the league in moves with 50, one ahead of juleon8's 49.
  • giJ03 has now lost seven straight head-to-head, tied for fourth on the all-time Longest Losing Streak list. He and showmeyourtd23 (82.80, the week's low score) are both 4-18.

Trades count once for each team involved. Records are regular season and include league-median games.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 18-4, two games clear, and leads the league in points.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs. 10-12 after a Week 11 win over MayockJr.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 10-12 after back-to-back head-to-head wins, the latest over the league leader.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 15-7 and third after a 2-0 Week 11. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also second in the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.elysianbeer: Top score in Weeks 2, 4 and 10, the most weekly highs of 2026. 12-10 and fourth after an 0-2 Week 11. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.Bjspjs4: 11-11 with eight trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 4-18 with seven straight head-to-head losses, and his Week 2 55.74 is already on the all-time low-score list. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
